product.description: Monoprice™1 3/4" Cable Pass‑Through Hole Saw Plate with Brush OpeningEliminate Messy Cable Runs with a Simple, Stylish Wall SolutionThe 1 3/4" Cable Pass‑Through Hole Saw Plate with Brush Opening is the perfect solution for achieving a clean, professional cable management setup in your home or office. Designed with both functionality and aesthetics in mind, this innovative wall plate allows you to route low‑voltage cables‑such as HDMI®, coaxial, speaker wire, or network cables‑neatly through the wall while keeping your space organized and clutter‑free. Available in sleek black or crisp white, it blends seamlessly with any décor, ensuring your AV setup or workstation looks polished and modern.Unlike traditional cable plates that require separate mounting brackets, the Hole Saw Plate with Brush Opening features integrated metal mounting wings molded directly into the plate. These wings secure the plate firmly against the drywall, eliminating the need for additional hardware and reducing installation time. Whether you're a professional installer or a DIY enthusiast, this design makes setup faster, easier, and more reliable. Simply cut a hole using a 1 3/4" hole saw, insert the plate, tighten the screws, and enjoy a secure and streamlined finish.The brush opening is another standout feature, providing a simple yet effective way to pass cables through the wall while maintaining a tidy appearance. The dense bristles create a flexible seal that allows multiple cables to pass through without leaving unsightly gaps, helping to prevent dust buildup and preserve a clean look around your AV or networking equipment.Ideal for wall‑mounted TVs, home theater systems, gaming consoles, office workstations, or structured cabling setups, this pass‑through plate is built for both convenience and durability.
